definition_en: The special words or phrases used in a particular field of study or work.
example_en: Legal terminology can be very difficult for people to understand clearly.
example_uz: Yuridik terminologiya odamlar uchun tushunishga juda qiyin bo'lishi mumkin.

definition_en: A man who is polite and behaves in a respectful way to other people.
example_en: The gentleman kindly held the heavy door open for the old lady.
example_uz: Bu janob keksa ayol uchun og'ir eshikni muloyimlik bilan ushlab turdi.

definition_en: A substance in food that helps your body to digest food properly.
example_en: Eating enough fibre is important for maintaining a healthy digestive system daily.
example_uz: Sog'lom ovqat hazm qilish tizimi uchun yetarli miqdorda kletchatka iste'mol qilish muhim.

definition_en: To decide officially in a court of law that someone is guilty of a crime.
example_en: The court convicted the man of stealing after hearing all the evidence.
example_uz: Sud barcha dalillarni tinglagach, erkakni o'g'rilikda aybdor deb topdi.

definition_en: Plural of index; signs or signals that measure the progress of something.
example_en: Economic indices show that the country is recovering from the recent crisis.
example_uz: Iqtisodiy ko'rsatkichlar mamlakat yaqindagi inqirozdan tiklanayotganini ko'rsatmoqda.

definition_en: Computer software that automatically displays or downloads advertising material when it is used.
example_en: My computer started running slowly after I accidentally installed some unwanted adware.
example_uz: Tasodifan keraksiz reklamali dasturni o'rnatganimdan so'ng kompyuterim sekin ishlay boshladi.

definition_en: Expressing an intention to cause harm or trouble to someone.
example_en: He left a threatening message on my phone after our heated argument.
example_uz: Janjalimizdan so'ng u telefonimga tahdid soluvchi xabar yozib qoldirdi.

definition_en: A person who speaks on behalf of an organization or a group of people.
example_en: The spokesman for the company refused to comment on the recent scandal.
example_uz: Kompaniya vakili so'nggi mojarolar haqida izoh berishdan bosh tortdi.

definition_en: People who work hard to change society or political systems.
example_en: Local activists are gathering in the park to protest against pollution.
example_uz: Mahalliy faollar ifloslanishga qarshi norozilik bildirish uchun bog'ga yig'ilishmoqda.

definition_en: A long and thin cooked sausage, often eaten inside a bread roll.
example_en: I usually have a grilled frankfurt with mustard for a quick lunch.
example_uz: Men tez tushlik uchun ko'pincha gorchitsa bilan qovurilgan sosiska yeyman.

definition_en: A person who is kept in a prison as a punishment.
example_en: The prisoner was allowed to receive visitors once every two weeks.
example_uz: Mahbusga har ikki haftada bir marta mehmon qabul qilishga ruxsat berildi.

definition_en: A small wild flower with a yellow center and white petals.
example_en: The children were running through the fields picking pretty yellow daisies.
example_uz: Bolalar dalada yugurib, chiroyli momoqaymoqlarni terib yurishardi.

definition_en: A small blinking line on a computer screen showing where you are typing.
example_en: Move your cursor to the top of the page and click save.
example_uz: Kursorni sahifaning yuqori qismiga olib boring va saqlash tugmasini bosing.

definition_en: The act of changing the way something is organized or built.
example_en: The company is undergoing a major restructuring to improve its efficiency.
example_uz: Kompaniya samaradorligini oshirish uchun katta qayta tashkil etish jarayonidan o'tmoqda.

definition_en: Small animals with six legs and bodies divided into three parts.
example_en: Many different types of insects live in the tropical rainforest.
example_uz: Tropik o'rmonlarda hasharotlarning juda ko'p turlari yashaydi.

definition_en: In a natural, raw state without being processed or refined.
example_en: The refinery processes crude oil into fuel for our cars.
example_uz: Neftni qayta ishlash zavodi xom neftni avtomobillarimiz uchun yoqilg'iga aylantiradi.

definition_en: To a degree that is enough for a particular purpose.
example_en: Make sure the metal is sufficiently heated before you try to bend it.
example_uz: Metallni egishdan oldin uning yetarlicha qiziganiga ishonch hosil qiling.

definition_en: An evergreen shrub with shiny leaves and small white flowers.
example_en: The scent of blooming myrtle filled the air in the garden.
example_uz: Bog'dagi havo gullagan mirtning hidi bilan to'lib ketdi.

definition_en: The process of making a place or object clean and tidy.
example_en: The whole team helped with the cleanup after the big party ended.
example_uz: Katta ziyofatdan keyin butun jamoa joyni tozalashga yordamlashdi.

definition_en: Thread made of wool or cotton used for making clothes by knitting or weaving.
example_en: She bought some soft blue yarn to knit a sweater for winter.
example_uz: U qishga sviter to'qish uchun yumshoq ko'k ip sotib oldi.

definition_en: To make clothes or fabric by connecting loops of thread using long needles.
example_en: My grandmother taught me how to knit a scarf when I was young.
example_uz: Yoshligimda buvim menga sharf to'qishni o'rgatgan edi.

definition_en: Something that will only happen if another event or action happens first.
example_en: The loan was conditional upon him finding a stable job very soon.
example_uz: Kredit uning tez orada barqaror ish topishi sharti bilan berildi.

definition_en: A large cup used for hot drinks, typically with a handle.
example_en: I drink a large mug of coffee every single morning to wake up.
example_uz: Men uyg'onish uchun har kuni ertalab bir katta krujka qahva ichaman.

definition_en: A game where you fill words into a grid based on given clues.
example_en: He likes to solve a crossword puzzle while waiting for the bus.
example_uz: U avtobus kutayotganda krossvord yechishni yaxshi ko'radi.

definition_en: To annoy someone or make them feel slightly worried or uncomfortable.
example_en: I am sorry to bother you, but do you have the time?
example_uz: Sizni bezovta qilganim uchun uzr, soat necha bo'lganini bilasizmi?

definition_en: Based on ideas or concepts rather than practical experience or reality.
example_en: We defined a conceptual model before designing the real thing.
example_uz: Haqiqiy narsani loyihalashdan oldin biz uning nazariy modelini ishlab chiqdik.

definition_en: The activity of making clothes by connecting wool threads with two special needles.
example_en: I find knitting very relaxing.
example_uz: To'qish menga xotirjamlik bag'ishlaydi.

definition_en: A small country located in the Himalayas in South Asia.
example_en: Bhutan is famous for measuring its success by national happiness.
example_uz: Butan o'z muvaffaqiyatini milliy baxt darajasi bilan o'lchashi bilan mashhur.

definition_en: A very small European country between Switzerland and Austria.
example_en: Liechtenstein is one of the smallest countries in the world.
example_uz: Lixtenshteyn dunyodagi eng kichik davlatlardan biri.

definition_en: To calculate a result using mathematics or a computer.
example_en: Can anyone here compute the square root of 10201?
example_uz: Bu yerda kimdir 10201 ning kvadrat ildizini hisoblay oladimi?

definition_en: A person who has naturally red hair.
example_en: My cousin is a redhead, just like our grandfather.
example_uz: Jiyanim xuddi bobomiz kabi qizil sochli.

definition_en: A person who changes words from one language into another language.
example_en: The translator helped us understand the document written in French.
example_uz: Tarjimon fransuz tilida yozilgan hujjatni tushunishimizga yordam berdi.

definition_en: A powerful vehicle used on farms to pull heavy equipment.
example_en: The farmer uses a tractor to plow his large fields.
example_uz: Fermer o'zining katta dalalarini haydash uchun traktordan foydalanadi.

definition_en: One of the seven very large main areas of land on the Earth.
example_en: Australia is the smallest continent in the world by total land area.
example_uz: Avstraliya yer yuzidagi eng kichik qit'a hisoblanadi.

definition_en: To remove the paper or material covering an object.
example_en: She sat on the floor to unwrap her birthday present carefully.
example_uz: U tug'ilgan kun sovg'asini ehtiyotkorlik bilan ochish uchun yerga o'tirdi.

definition_en: The distance of a place east or west from the prime meridian.
example_en: The ship's captain calculated the exact longitude to find their location.
example_uz: Kema kapitani o'z manzilini aniqlash uchun aniq uzunlikni hisoblab chiqdi.

definition_en: A long wooden pole with a sharp metal point used as a weapon.
example_en: Medieval soldiers often used a pike to defend against charging horses.
example_uz: O'rta asr askarlari hujum qilayotgan otlarga qarshi ko'pincha nayzadan foydalangan.

definition_en: Giving more protection from danger or risk than another thing.
example_en: It is much safer to drive slowly when the roads are icy.
example_uz: Yo'llar muzlaganda sekin haydash ancha xavfsizroq.

definition_en: The act of putting something into something else.
example_en: The insertion of the new clause clarified the terms of the contract.
example_uz: Yangi bandning kiritilishi shartnoma shartlarini aniqlashtirdi.

definition_en: The arrangement of a piece of music to be played by different musical instruments.
example_en: The composer is known for his unique instrumentation in classical symphony pieces.
example_uz: Bastakor klassik simfoniya asarlaridagi o'ziga xos cholg'ulash uslubi bilan tanilgan.

definition_en: A limit or restriction that makes it difficult to do something as planned.
example_en: Lack of time was a major constraint on the success of the project.
example_uz: Vaqt tanqisligi loyiha muvaffaqiyatiga katta cheklov bo'ldi.

definition_en: Water that is found naturally under the surface of the earth.
example_en: Farmers often rely on groundwater to irrigate their crops during dry seasons.
example_uz: Fermerlar quruq mavsumda ekinlarini sug'orish uchun ko'pincha yerosti suvlaridan foydalanadilar.

definition_en: A pleasant-smelling liquid that people put on their skin to smell nice.
example_en: He put on a little cologne before going out for dinner tonight.
example_uz: U bugun kechki ovqatga chiqishdan oldin biroz atir sepdi.

definition_en: To reduce the file size of digital data using specific software compression.
example_en: You need to gzip the log files before sending them to the server.
example_uz: Jurnal fayllarini serverga yuborishdan oldin ularni siqishingiz kerak.

definition_en: A person whose job is to protect and look after a large forest area.
example_en: The park ranger helped us find the best trail through the woods.
example_uz: O'rmonchi bizga o'rmon ichidagi eng yaxshi so'qmoqni topishga yordam berdi.

definition_en: Material used to keep heat or cold inside a building or pipe.
example_en: Better insulation in the attic will keep the whole house warmer today.
example_uz: Chordoqdagi yaxshiroq izolyatsiya bugun butun uyni issiqroq saqlaydi.

definition_en: A low area of wet, soft land where many types of plants grow.
example_en: Many different birds make their homes in the tall grass of the marsh.
example_uz: Ko'plab turli xil qushlar botqoqlikdagi baland o'tlar orasida uya quradi.

definition_en: A key on a computer keyboard used to perform specific shortcut commands.
example_en: You can copy the text by holding the Ctrl key and pressing C.
example_uz: Matnni Ctrl tugmasini bosib turib C harfi orqali nusxalab olishingiz mumkin.

definition_en: Feeling afraid or worried that something bad might happen to you.
example_en: I was scared that I would miss the bus this morning at work.
example_uz: Men bugun ertalab ishga ketayotganda avtobusdan qolib ketishdan qo'rqdim.

definition_en: An action that breaks a law, rule, or agreement.
example_en: Downloading illegal music is a serious copyright infringement for all users.
example_uz: Nolegal musiqalarni yuklab olish barcha foydalanuvchilar uchun jiddiy mualliflik huquqi buzilishidir.

definition_en: Not straight; curved or having an angle.
example_en: The metal bar was badly bent after the heavy truck hit it.
example_uz: Yuk mashinasi urilgandan so‘ng metall to‘sin qattiq egilib qoldi.

definition_en: Based on personal feelings and opinions rather than facts.
example_en: Beauty is subjective because everyone likes different things in this world.
example_uz: Go‘zallik subyektiv tushuncha, chunki bu dunyoda har kimga har xil narsa yoqadi.

definition_en: Protection given by a government to someone who has left their own country.
example_en: The political activist requested asylum to avoid being arrested in his country.
example_uz: Siyosiy faol o‘z mamlakatida qamalmaslik uchun boshpana so‘radi.

definition_en: A drink usually made by mixing several alcoholic drinks together.
example_en: They served a delicious fruit cocktail at the summer garden party.
example_uz: Yozgi bog‘ ziyofatida mazali mevali kokteyl taklif qilishdi.

definition_en: Different types or kinds of the same thing.
example_en: The shop sells many varieties of apples from all over the world.
example_uz: Do'konda dunyoning turli burchaklaridan keltirilgan olma xillari juda ko'p.

definition_en: A pleasant, shaded area in a garden with climbing plants on a light structure.
example_en: We sat in the wooden arbor to escape the hot afternoon sun.
example_uz: Tushdagi jaziramadan qochish uchun biz yog'och shiyponda o'tirdik.

definition_en: A substance that causes illness or death when swallowed or breathed in.
example_en: Keep all household chemicals and poison away from young children.
example_uz: Barcha maishiy kimyoviy moddalar va zaharlarni yosh bolalardan uzoqroq tuting.
